title: Seasonal QA Process Lab Tech (Crew C)

cond_0001.intro: The Seasonal Quality Assurance Lab Technician will be responsible for ensuring product quality is monitored and tested in compliance with established procedures, specifications, and instructions. The individual in this position is responsible for, but not limited to, taking samples and performing tests as prescribed by procedure or specification, reporting to appropriate personnel on the status of line operations, performing requested tests and samples, and recording information in logs and databases.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Accurately completes quality grade using grading standards.
Accurately enters all product identity information for all product produced in an inventory database.
Performs requested tests and samples.
Maintains a safe work environment.
Provides prompt and timely feedback to appropriate personnel relative to production related problems (i.e. Excessive defects, mislabeling, package quality issues, downtime and increased production etc).
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High school diploma or GED
Basic math skills
Ability to use basic lab equipment
Good communication skills
Ability to work in refrigerated and frozen environments
Ability to sit and stand for long periods
Ability to lift 50 pounds
Adheres to all standards, policies, and systems as appropriate
Preferred Requirements
Good knowledge of computer systems
Organized, efficient, and good time management skills
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

This includes coordinating with appropriate personnel on line status, sharing updates on production issues, and supporting accurate recordkeeping in logs and databases.
cond_0531.responsibilities:
Work with team members to accurately complete quality grading using established grading standards.
Coordinate with production staff to enter all product identity information into the inventory database.
Carry out requested tests and collect samples as directed by procedure or specification.
Help maintain a safe work environment.
Share prompt and timely feedback with appropriate personnel regarding production-related issues (e.g., excessive defects, mislabeling, package quality issues, downtime, increased production).
cond_0531.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High school diploma or GED
Basic math skills
Ability to use basic lab equipment
Good communication skills
Ability to work in refrigerated and frozen environments
Ability to sit and stand for long periods
Ability to lift 50 pounds
Adheres to all standards, policies, and systems as appropriate
Preferred Requirements
Good knowledge of computer systems
Organized, efficient, and able to manage time well
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
